_doc: n8n's own mail: invitations and forgot-password. READY, NOT IN USE: nothing reads this sender until pieces/n8n/mail/ is named in overlays/dev, which waits for its DNS (AWS granted SES production access on 2026-11-04; n8n.recomex.eu is the one sender domain not verified) and for the owner's choice to turn it on. n8n takes SMTP only: it reads this sender's key from email-sender as the relay password (plunk-smtp.<apex>:587, user plunk). One sender for every n8n instance.
